fields.qe: digi_arapuca_sbnd.fcl:25, digi_arapuca_sbnd.fcl:26: sbndcode's detection efficiencies, per real photon: sbndcode divides each by ScintPreScale (DigiArapucaSBNDAlg.cc:13, 14, 15) and applies it to the photons Geant4 tracked; it reads direct (VUV) light below the edge, reflected (visible) light above (opDetDigitizerWorker.cc:212, 233, 362, 371); the bands meet at 6.19 eV (200.3 nm), where larsim's PhotonHitConverter files a photon as VUV (above the energy) or visible (LArSoft/larsim v10_22_01 (commit 72d698f8dece3570bd70b20ddfc63eb5544aaae6) larsim/PhotonHitConverter/PhotonHitConverter_module.cc:114, 132)
fields.tts: SBNSoftware/sbnd_data v01_42_00 (commit 8f3deb61ebe4ea61fa09e8b5721394be64ed1c63) OpDetSim/digi_arapuca_sbnd.root TimeXArapucaVUV: the photon time inside the VUV box, read in 1 ns bins, on direct light (DigiArapucaSBNDAlg.cc:118, 192, 289)
fields.gain: digi_arapuca_sbnd.fcl:20: ADC at the single photoelectron's peak

choices.efficiency: 1: no per-sensor scale beyond the detection efficiency in qe
choices.frontend/charge_scale: 1: the charge in units of the single photoelectron
choices.frontend/charge_noise_pe: 0: no charge noise beyond the single photoelectron's spread (charge)
choices.frontend/window_ns: 0: no integration window (each photoelectron its own pulse or hit)
choices.frontend/charge_step_pe: 0.25: the charge histogram's step, a quarter of a photoelectron
choices.t_offset_ns: 0: sbndcode adds no transit or cable delay to an X-ARAPUCA photon
choices.charge/fraction: 0: sbndcode's amplitude fluctuation is Gaussian only (no exponential part)
choices.ranges: the bounds of each timing value a fit may reach: lumen:sensor builds its static time grid for them (a value outside is refused); not experiment data. A time spread's width has none here: its range is lumen's derived one (lumen.rules.choices.TIME_SPREAD_REACH)

provenance.warning: sbndcode v10_26_00 draws the time tables with CLHEP::RandGeneral, in [0, 1) ns; this set reads them in 1 ns bins, as sbnd_pmt does timeTPB. Not modelled: the SiPM cross-talk (digi_arapuca_sbnd.fcl:16: 0.424 of photoelectrons count twice) and the DAPHNE waveform (readout hits); the visible light a VUV X-ARAPUCA reads is timed with TimeXArapucaVUV, where sbndcode adds timeTPB (DigiArapucaSBNDAlg.cc:138)
